minutes.headline: Sewer Commission authorized more money for sewer inspection work and for new manhole frames and covers.
minutes.summary: The commission deferred officer elections until a full commission is present. Most of the night went to a heated dispute over a capped inflow and infiltration work vote, procurement, and the Charter division of roles between the commission and the DPW. It voted on the flow isolation and camera work and on manhole frames and covers, and reviewed permit fee notices.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to replace its earlier capped vote with a higher authorization for flow isolation and TV camera work.
The commission authorized funding for replacement manhole frames and covers.
The commission voted to wait on electing officers until a full commission is present; current officers continue.
Members agreed to discuss procurement with the town manager present, after a long dispute over the capped work and the commission's role versus the DPW's.
A vote to assess a privilege fee on a property changed from condo to two-family was held, but the outcome was not audible.

why_it_matters: Sewer inspection and manhole work is paid through sewer funds, so higher authorizations for it can bear on sewer bills.
The dispute over who procures and approves this work, the commission or the DPW, decides who answers for sewer spending.
watch_next: A future commission meeting on procurement with the town manager present.
The election of officers, once a full commission is present.
